summary: Unidentified adult man fell through the ice on a pond at Sand Creek Park in Aurora while walking three dogs; Aurora Fire Rescue responded shortly after 7 p.m., pulled the man and one of the dogs from the water, and took the man to a hospital in critical condition, where he later died; South Metro Fire Rescue's dive team searched the pond and found no other victims; all three dogs survived
location: Sand Creek Park pond (2700 N. Peoria St.), Aurora
responding_agency: Aurora Fire Rescue; South Metro Fire Rescue
notes: Freshness sweep 2026-11-21: The Denver Post 2026-11-18 (parent-opened live), reporting from the Aurora Fire Rescue news release and PIO Eric Hurst; fell through ice Tue Nov 17 ~7 p.m. while walking three dogs; man unidentified at publication, to be identified by the Adams County Coroner's Office; one dog also pulled from the water; all three dogs survived, cared for by Aurora Animal Services.
